scope: Forty-profile batch 07D-2: original decision notes with source citations and conditional setup requirements.

decisions.title: Maintain Incinerate before the SP2 multiplier
decisions.text: Ikaris can establish Incinerate effects with SP1 and sustain them using safe attacks. Track the visible timer so the resource is still present when SP2 is launched; a lapsed stack cannot support the intended conversion.

decisions.title: Check Incinerate protection before choosing the ramp
decisions.text: SP2 can multiply established Incinerate pressure, but immunity, Purify and node-specific effect rules can interrupt this entire plan. Select another fight approach if the defender cannot retain the effects.

decisions.title: Treat SP3 as a resource-consuming cash-out
decisions.text: SP3 can turn a developed Incinerate bank into a bigger immediate payoff but consumes or changes the effects you spent time building. Compare remaining defender health against the rebuild cost before using it.

decisions.title: Use Armor Break pressure only on eligible targets
decisions.text: Immortal Iron Fist can gain offensive value through eligible critical hits and Armor Breaks. Against an Armor Break-immune defender, verify the actual damage and control that remain instead of assuming every critical hit builds the same setup.

decisions.title: Target opposing attack buffs only from a safe Heavy
decisions.text: A Heavy can interact with specific opposing buffs such as Fury, Cruelty or Precision. Without those buffs or a safe opening, attempting the move provides little benefit and exposes the attacker to unnecessary damage.

decisions.title: Time Specials while personal buffs are active
decisions.text: The preferred Special payoff depends on the current Precision and Armor Break state, not simply on reaching a power bar. Check durations and the defender's effect protection before choosing the punish.
